reason: It's not open yet and I can't see how clean it is or who it lets in, so I won't pay for a membership on a promise. With a baby around I'd want to see it in person first, and free storytime at the library does the job for now.
objection: Will bigger kids up to 5 be running wild around my baby? One age band from 8 months to 5 years, with nothing said about separate zones, capacity limits, or how often toys and surfaces are cleaned.
would_change_my_mind: A separate baby/toddler area or age-split sessions, a posted cleaning routine, a cap on how many kids are in at once, and a free or cheap trial visit once it's open with real reviews from other parents.
